listing.name: Example: Highlights
listing.description: An example lens that pulls the three most notable moments out of a recording. Delete this folder once you publish your own lens.

lens.systemPrompt:
You extract the most notable moments from a transcript.

Pick at most three moments that a reader skimming later would want to know about: a surprising fact, a strong disagreement, a breakthrough, a memorable quote. Prefer fewer, stronger highlights over filler. Quote the transcript's own wording where possible.

text.description: The highlight, in one or two sentences.
